documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For Period Ended June 30, 2026.
JUBLCPL: Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Unsecured Creditors To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Equity Shareholders To Be Held On September 05, 2026.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,852 million and full-year FY26 revenue of INR 18,911 million. Growth was led by the adhesives and P&K fertilizers segments, while replacement tyres and industrial polymers faced demand softness. Input cost pressures increased in raw materials such as Sulphur and Acid due to geopolitical disruptions, which management is mitigating via calibrated price increases. Additionally, the company plans to commence operations at its new polymer facility in Samlya, Gujarat in Q1 FY27 and is proceeding with the demerger of its Agri business. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited presented its Q3 and 9M-FY26 financial results, reporting Q3 FY26 revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million and EBITDA of INR 393 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will commence its polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: An R&D center at the Samlya plant facilitates the development of a new range of SBR latex.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved expanding Performance Polymers manufacturing capacity by 30,000 MTPA at the Samlya site.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity expansion requires an investment of approximately INR 50 Crores.
The Board approved a ~Rs. 50 crore capex for expanding manufacturing facilities in the Performance Polymers and Chemical segment at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned expansion will be funded mostly via internal accruals and will add 30,000 MT per annum of capacity to the Performance Polymers business.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
